Name: The Little Things - Haley
Author: GoldfishMassacre
Description:
A lore-friendly and simple overhaul of Haleys portraits.
This is an updated version of my very [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1641]old mod[/url]﻿, now converted to work with Content Patcher and patch 1.6!
Includes all portraits(at least now it does, whoops).

[b]Installation:[/b]
1. Install SMAPI
2. Install Content Patcher
3. Put the TLTHaley folder in your mods folder.
Done!

PSA:
I haven't tested it extensively yet, and I'm not an experienced modder, so install at your own risk!

Downloads.Description: New and improved. Again! (I actually forgot some portraits so do get this one.)
